title: SEO Audit
summary: Find out what is holding your existing website back in Google search.
outcome: Website audit report with problems and suggested priorities.

title: Keyword Research
summary: Find the searches customers use for your products or services, even before you have a website.
outcome: Keyword research spreadsheet grouped by topic.

title: On-Page SEO
summary: Review page titles, headings, wording and links so visitors can understand what each page offers.
outcome: Specific recommendations for improving existing pages.

title: Technical SEO
summary: Check why important pages may not appear in Google and find issues with speed, redirects or page access.
outcome: Technical problem list with recommended checks and fixes.

title: SEO Competitor Analysis
summary: See which competitor pages appear in Google and what useful topics your business may be missing.

title: SEO Content Optimization
summary: Review existing website text and plan content that answers the questions your customers search for.

title: Local SEO
summary: Check how customers can find your business in local Google searches and on Maps, where relevant.
outcome: Local search visibility review and recommendations.

title: International SEO
summary: Check whether people in each target country can find the right language version of your website.
outcome: Review of language pages and country-specific search issues.

title: SEO Consultation
summary: Discuss your business goals, ask SEO questions and decide which work is worth doing first.
outcome: Practical guidance; a written plan is quoted separately.
